reasons: § 7.2 plainly runs against us — Customer must offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best given to any other technology supplier — with no product, term, or comparison limits, so it fails the fallback and sits in the rule's walk-away territory; the deviation classification is correct.

The redline deletes p0027 in full, which is exactly the redline guidance ('delete the obligation on Customer; keep any Vendor-granted MFN') and is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position; no Vendor-granted MFN language is disturbed.

The comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, and the noted conflict with § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no most-favoured-customer commitment) is supported by the quoted text; tone and prefix conform.
